_doc: Manifest of bundles/places-v0.1.1 (SPEC 2), written by bin/py -m places.export --release v0.1.1. files: the sha256 and bytes of every other file in the bundle (a file can't carry its own hash). inputs: the repo files the numbers are computed from. sources: every upstream file a number depends on (the CES SM files, the Census CBSA estimates of row P1, the QCEW area-slice heads of row X1 and the pinned geography and weight files), with url, sha256, bytes, Last-Modified, ETag and fetched_at. code: the last commit that changed the export's code paths, whether they differ from it, and each file's sha256. Nothing records when the export ran, so two runs write the same bytes.
